name: Caterpillar - Morton IL Global Parts Distribution Center
type: Parts distribution center (anchor depot, 3M+ sq ft)

fieldNotes.site: Caterpillar Morton Global Parts Distribution Center - the company's anchor depot (~3M+ sq ft, original Cat Logistics HQ). Geocoded point lands inside the complex; confirmed by scale, layout and adjacency to I-74 in Morton IL.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Whole campus is continuously fenced (ornamental steel on the west along Detroit Ave, chain-link/green-screen on the south along the rail line, chain-link on the highway-frontage east). Truck operations and storage yards sit behind that fence, implying controlled truck access. No barrier arm or booth could be cleanly imaged - SE/SW frontages are residential, W/E frontages are screened by employee parking. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth positively identified in available satellite/Street View - flagged uncertain. remoteGs set true on the assumption of kiosk/badge access at a fenced depot, also flagged.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Anchor parts depot with multiple very large buildings; dock-door banks confirmed on the east building (trailers backed in - 2022 Street View) and along internal faces. Estimated 50+ total; low confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large interior trailer/material storage yards on the SE and rows of stored equipment - 25-50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity on the east building is physically separate from material yards and dock faces on the south/SW side.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail line runs immediately along the south edge of the property with spur access into the storage yards.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multiple distinct very large buildings on one campus (anchor parts depot complex).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Morton IL, bordered by I-74 and a rail corridor with residential and small commercial nearby - small-town industrial, classed Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified; left false.
fieldNotes.metrics: Counts are honest estimates from overhead imagery of a very large multi-building depot; flagged.

citations.claim: Caterpillar Morton Distribution Center fact sheet (caterpillar.com asset): global parts depot at 500 N. Morton Ave, Morton IL; 375,000+ part numbers.

verification.rationale: CAT-operated anchor global parts distribution center (3M+ sq ft); confirmed via Caterpillar own Morton DC fact sheet; no divestiture/closure.
